subject: math
cluster: Identify and describe shapes (squares, circles, triangles, rectangles, hexagons, cubes, cones, cylinders, and spheres)

items.prompt:
A triangle pointing down is
A) still a triangle
B) a square
C) a circle
D) not a shape

A tilted square is
A) a circle
B) still a square
C) a triangle
D) a cone

Does turning a shape change its name?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only triangles
D) Only circles

steps: A shape keeps its name when turned.

items.prompt:
A big circle and a small circle are
A) both circles
B) different shapes
C) squares
D) triangles

steps: Size does not change the name.

items.prompt:
A rectangle turned sideways is
A) still a rectangle
B) a square
C) a circle
D) a triangle

A triangle turned any way has how many sides?
A) $3$
B) $4$
C) $5$
D) $0$

Does making a square bigger change its name?
A) Yes
B) No
C) It becomes a circle
D) It becomes a cube

steps: Size does not change the name.

items.prompt:
A triangle that is flipped over is
A) still a triangle
B) a square
C) a circle
D) a line
